concept.title: What's new in Lightwell Network
concept.shortdesc: Stay up to date about new Lightwell Network features that you can use to keep your open source dependencies secure.

dlentry.dt: Predisclosure repository added to Lightwell Network

dd.p: The Predisclosure repository is now available in the . This repository builds on the existing Remediated repository by delivering fixes for novel vulnerabilities before public disclosure.

ul.li: Packages in this repository are built on the latest remediated builds and are maintained with moderate and higher severity CVE fixes.
As vulnerabilities are publicly disclosed and addressed upstream, corresponding fixes are promoted from the Predisclosure repository into the Remediated repository.

Repository migration: Novel fixes are moved directly into the predisclosure repository. If you previously mirrored or pulled these specific artifacts into a local repository, such as JFrog Artifactory, they will no longer be available at their former Remediated path.
Existing novel builds: Pre-existing novel fixes moved during this update do not retrospectively display the new -nxxxx suffix. Only newly created builds reflect the updated versioning format.
